name: pdfops
summary: Python client for the PDFops API: fill AcroForm PDFs, merge and split PDFs, page operations (extract, delete, rotate, watermark, page numbers), protect and unlock, edit metadata, inspect form fields, extract and search text, stamp, add fields, detect fields on flat PDFs, attach files, convert HTML, text and images to PDF, generate invoices (including Factur-X). One HTTP call, no native deps, no headless browser.
